translationRepairs: That day he was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.
That day the army was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.

Focus 是日，果為晉軍及鎮、定之師所敗 has no personal subject, and 都將…餘眾奔潰 describes an army rout, so idiomatic 'he' wrongly attaches the defeat to the Emperor of s0043. The proposed 'northern force' invents a geographic label absent from this unit and the supplied window; render the omitted subject as 'the army', matching s0042 兵可憂矣.
Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Yanzhou on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.
Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Salt Prefecture (鹽州) on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.
Focus 今月五日收鹽州 names Salt Prefecture (鹽州), distinct from the reporter's seat 延州節度使. Idiomatic English wrongly reused Yanzhou for both; Salt Prefecture (鹽州) restores the captured place.
